currentParagraphText: “Just wait,” the Viper said, his eyes wide open as he had a big grin on his face, having finally realized what Jake was trying to do. The result of combining two skills and opportunities like that wasn’t something Vilas had even considered, but he would definitely be interested in hearing the outcome from Jake later on.
